description: This file defines the QueryBasedContentDeploymentStepDriver class, which manages the display, editing, and updating of deployment steps related to query-based content in OrchardCore. It interacts with query management and localization services, and handles JSON query parameters validation.

classes.name: QueryBasedContentDeploymentStepDriver
classes.description: A display driver class for managing query-based content deployment steps, including display, edit, and update functionalities.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Generates display results for the deployment step, including summary and thumbnail views.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the view model for editing the deployment step, populating it with current data and available queries.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes the submitted form data to update the deployment step, including validation of query parameters and content items.
